message: All IAM resource ARNs hardcode account ID '111111111111'. Delegation templates are applied across customer accounts — this template will fail in any account other than 111111111111. Replace with '@{AccountId}' parameter or '*'.

iam:GetRole is grouped with iam:CreateRole and iam:PutRolePolicy under an iam:PermissionsBoundary condition. GetRole will fail on pre-existing roles without this boundary. Split read actions into a separate statement without the boundary condition.
The permission boundary contains only Allow statements with no explicit Deny for dangerous write operations. Adding explicit Deny provides defense-in-depth against future boundary expansions.
